2609.04590.title: Dual-Part Multi-Lateral Branched Network for Multi-Class Segmentation in Cardiovascular Catheterization Angiograms
2609.04590.paper_summary: Catheterisation image processing requires segmentation models that are fast, accurate and explainable. While most of the existing studies usually focus on binary segmentation, there is a recent demand for simultaneous segmentation of multiple structures found in catheterization scenes. In this study, a dual-part MLBNet architecture is designed with multi-lateral encoder blocks and multi-head decoder branches for class-aware segmentation in cardiovascular catheterization scenes. Lateral branches in the encoder enables repeated feature extraction to learn diverse shared representations, while multiple decoder heads are used to introduce class-skewed branches that specialize in different structural properties in catheterization scenes. To analyze the performances of the dual-part MLBNet architecture, several multi-class segmentation angiogram data obtained during cardiovascular catheterization in phantom models, synthetic human-simulated aorta, and animal model are used for model training and evaluation. Results obtained showed the dual-part models could effectively separate guidewire, catheter, vessels and background pixels to their classes of memberships with high probability. The results demonstrate that all models were able to distinguish the dominant background class from foreground structures with high overall accuracy.
2609.04590.paper_summary_zh: 導管影像處理需要快速、準確且可解釋的分割模型。雖然大多數現有研究通常專注於二元分割，但最近對於同時分割導管場景中多個結構的需求增加。在本研究中，設計了一種雙部分的MLBNet架構，具有多邊編碼器區塊和多頭解碼器分支，以實現心血管導管場景中的類別感知分割。編碼器中的側邊分支使得重複特徵提取成為可能，以學習多樣化的共享表示，而多個解碼器頭則用於引入專注於導管場景中不同結構特性的類別偏斜分支。為了分析雙部分MLBNet架構的性能，使用了在幻影模型、合成的人類模擬主動脈和動物模型中獲得的多類別分割血管造影數據進行模型訓練和評估。獲得的結果顯示，雙部分模型能夠有效地將導絲、導管、血管和背景像素分離到它們的類別中，並具有高概率的隸屬性。結果證明，所有模型都能以高整體準確度區分主導背景類別和前景結構。
